fixture: Passive clock ticks are paused. Fair arrival supplies 198 coins; the harness seeds starting trust at 45 and skips to a later non-Friday morning (j01), then 16:00 (j02–j05). Later deals occur through the production offer on distinct calendar days (j10–j12). A second fair arrival starts the separate branch with six coins temporarily set for j06. The fair wallet is restored for the report to Saeed and the following afternoon (j07–j09).
method: Real native Godot viewport. Viewport-local clicks exercise fair arrival, the route to the Gate of Trust, the offer choices, the return to the gate map and What people say.
